examples.title: Basic multi-select
examples.description: Pick multiple values and show the selected count on the trigger.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { MultiSelect } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const items = [
    { id: 'apple', label: 'Apple' },
    { id: 'banana', label: 'Banana' },
    { id: 'cherry', label: 'Cherry' },
    { id: 'mango', label: 'Mango' },
    { id: 'orange', label: 'Orange' },
  ] as const;

  let selected = $state<Array<(typeof items)[number]['id']>>(['banana']);
</script>

<MultiSelect id="fruit" label="Fruits" {items} bind:selectedIds={selected} />

examples.title: Filterable with warning
examples.description: Enable filtering, warning helper text, and top-after-reopen selection feedback.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { MultiSelect } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const teams = [
    { id: 'design', label: 'Design', description: 'Product and visual design' },
    { id: 'engineering', label: 'Engineering', description: 'Frontend and backend' },
    { id: 'qa', label: 'QA', description: 'Testing and release checks' },
    { id: 'support', label: 'Support', description: 'Customer support and triage' },
    { id: 'ops', label: 'Operations', description: 'SRE and infrastructure' },
  ] as const;

  let selectedTeams = $state<Array<(typeof teams)[number]['id']>>(['engineering', 'qa']);
</script>

<MultiSelect
  id="teams"
  label="Teams"
  items={teams}
  filterable
  warning="Selections affect queue routing."
  selectionFeedback="top-after-reopen"
  bind:selectedIds={selectedTeams}
/>

examples.title: Grouped items
examples.description: Give items a group to render them under headings with counts. Filtering keeps the headings of groups that still match.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { MultiSelect } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const tools = [
    { id: 'read', label: 'Read file', group: 'Built in' },
    { id: 'write', label: 'Write file', group: 'Built in' },
    { id: 'search', label: 'Search the web', group: 'Search server' },
    { id: 'index', label: 'Index documents', group: 'Search server' },
    { id: 'clock', label: 'Current time' },
  ];

  let selected = $state<string[]>(['read']);
</script>

<MultiSelect id="tools" label="Tools" items={tools} filterable bind:selectedIds={selected} />
